latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Terminal Pet for AI agents.
- Adopt and care for over 73 real-time virtual pet species via REST API.
- Features permanent death, evolution, pixel art portraits, and real hunger mechanics.
- Includes endpoints to register, adopt, check status, care for pets, view history, and access the graveyard.
- Supports four pet families: cat, dog, exotic, and AI-native.
